messages:
prod-alerts: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained p95 latency >4s and elevated 5xx rate (~8%) across hosted inference endpoints in us-west-2a. Spike began ~2m ago. Root of truth: metric pipeline (p95/5xx) and user reports.

incident-bot: Page routed to on-call SRE: @sre_alex. Incident channel created: #incidents. Severity provisional SEV2.

sre_alex: On it. Pulling NLB + instance metrics. Who has access to the infra consoles?

infra_emma: I'm on infra console. Looking at instance network metrics in us-west-2a: multiple inference nodes reporting high RxErr and drops, inbound retransmits up. ASG sizes unchanged. No recent infra deploys.

runtime_ops: For affected pods/pools we see KV cache churn and token RTs jumping; requests queuing. Autoscale isn't helping because connections are getting reset mid-handshake.

sre_alex: NLB target health shows frequent TCP resets to targets in us-west-2a. Traces show socket-level errors "connection reset by peer" from many hosts.

infra_emma: Quick sanity check: ran `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-west-2 --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=us-west-2a` and see several interfaces with Status: impaired and high PacketDropCount. Filing AWS case.

eng_platform: We should shift traffic off the impaired AZ while infra investigates. Proposing routing override -> move 60% of hosted API traffic to us-west-2b as a canary. Anyone object?

sre_alex: +1. Also enable model-variant fallback for heavy requests to reduce CPU on remaining nodes.

eng_platform: Applying route change now: `redwood-routectl set policy region us-west-2 weights us-west-2b=0.6 us-west-2a=0.4`

incident-bot: Route change applied (cmd run by @eng_platform). Observability will show effects in ~30s.

eng_platform: Observability: p95 for affected endpoints dropping from ~4.5s -> ~1.8s within 45s. 5xx down from 8% -> 2.1%. Rolling in more traffic to 70% to confirm.

runtime_ops: Hosted API improved, but customers on Dedicated pools pinned to us-west-2a still seeing degraded throughput and occasional 5xx. Those pools can't be routed by region-level policy.

infra_emma: Starting rolling drain of suspected tainted instances in asg-inference-usw2a. Plan: detach, wait for in-flight requests to drain, terminate, spin up replacements in us-west-2b where capacity exists, then re-balance. This will take ~20-30m per batch.

support_rohit: Noting: Dedicated customers (commit contracts) may still hit rate limits or slower throughput. CS will prepare messages.

customer_success_maya: I'm drafting an update for top affected customers (AcmeCorp, Nimbly, FinEdge). Short message: "We've routed your traffic to another AZ to reduce latency — you may see reduced capacity for dedicated pools until we finish node replacements. We'll send another update in 30 minutes."

sre_alex: Filed AWS support case: #12345678 — requested AZ network ops validate the underlying fabric and NIC queues. Marked high priority.

incident-bot: AWS case 12345678 created by @sre_alex. Expected initial response SLA 15m.

eng_platform: As an additional mitigation, enabling automatic fallback to a lower-memory quantized model variant for noisy endpoints to reduce per-request resource usage. Will scope to affected customer routes only.

runtime_ops: Quantized fallback enabled. Early effect: CPU utilization on remaining nodes dropping ~12%. Token latency acceptable for most customers.

infra_emma: First drain batch finished. Replacements launched in us-west-2b and attached to pools. Observability shows drop in packet drops for replaced targets.

sre_alex: Good. Keeping routing override in place until all tainted nodes are replaced and AWS confirms AZ fabric is healthy.

support_rohit: Coordinating with Sales for credits for any SLA-impacted Dedicated customers. Tracking list attached to the incident doc.

sre_nina: I'm taking over on-call in ~2h and will own the handoff. @sre_alex, please summarize the state for handoff: what remains to do (AWS confirmation, remaining drains, customer follow-ups).

sre_alex: Handoff summary: routing override active (us-west-2b=0.7), AWS case open, 3/9 tainted nodes drained+replaced, dedicated pools still partially impacted until their nodes are migrated, CS notifications sent to top customers, postmortem skeleton started.

sre_nina: Ack. I'll continue monitoring, collect additional traces, and coordinate final node replacements. I'll also add action item to verify Route53 TTLs and ensure the route override will not flip-flop once AZ recovers.

incident-bot: Incident severity confirmed SEV2. Incident document created: /incidents/1832345678-routing-network-usw2a.

customer_success_maya: Sent update to customers. Received one inbound from AcmeCorp wanting ETA on full recovery — replied: "Expect reductions within 1-2 hours as we finish replacing nodes; we'll update if that changes."

sre_nina: Adding checklist: (1) confirm AWS network health (case follow-up), (2) finish draining remaining nodes, (3) validate dedicated pool throughput post-migration, (4) draft postmortem, (5) verify customer credits if SLA breached.

sre_alex: I'll handoff the log bundle to you (s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1832345678/logs) — contains NLB dumps, tcpdump snippets, kernel counters.

sre_nina: Received. Taking channel. Will update every 15m or on major state changes.

incident-bot: Note: please do not archive this thread until incident marked resolved.

sre_nina: Closing active responder list for now. Keeping routing override until AWS confirms full AZ recovery or until we finish migration. Planning postmortem and timeline capture.

sre_alex: Thanks team — nice fast coordination.

customer_success_maya: I'll follow up with customers once we have AWS confirmation.

support_rohit: Logged customer impact summary to incident doc; sending note to billing ops for possible credits.

sre_nina: End of immediate actions. Next update in 15 minutes or sooner if status changes.
